name: VSAR16
notes: National non-federal SAR channel; CTCSS may vary.

name: AIRGRD
notes: Emergency/initial contact air-ground; TX must carry 110.9 Hz. Listed for Alaska BLM/AICC too. Most AK dispatch centers (except Chugach, Tongass) monitor Air Guard.

name: NFF
notes: Flight following/dispatch air-ground; tone 110.9 on TX and RX. No Alaska dispatch center monitors NFF (Alaska uses AM flight following, see ak_state.csv).
